zh: 在「关于复古猫」中检查、下载并安装更新，也可开启启动时自动检查。
GitHub 无法连接或下载中断时，自动切换到 GHFast。更新包通过校验后，由安卓系统确认安装。
从 1.0.x 升级到本版需手动覆盖安装一次，之后可在应用内更新。
en: Check for, download, and install updates from About RetroMao, with an option to check automatically at startup.
Switch to GHFast when GitHub is unavailable or the download is interrupted. Verified updates are handed to Android for installation confirmation.
Install this version manually over 1.0.x once. Future updates can be installed from the app.
